observation: The execution-resilience watchdog existed, but new operations were not automatically enrolled and the worker only had a safe recovery handler for a narrow selftest case.
root_cause: Recovery metadata was optional and generic RESULT_UNKNOWN operations had no deterministic safe next action.
prevention_rule: Every newly created canonical operation is recovery-aware. A RESULT_UNKNOWN operation may be re-planned only when readback_before_replay is true and side_effect_state is NOT_STARTED; otherwise recovery remains fail-closed.
